rows.reason: notFound (:98) has three call sites. In readRecord (:223) it fires only when the store reports the key missing (read.value.missing), and both keys must exist: the completion round must equal chainHead taken from the canonical facts read (completion.ts:353-359; task-machine.ts:1108-1112), that head is a round the facts reader decoded from the store (plan-readers.ts:1840-1853), and a round opens only after readExecution returned its subject Run (evidence-service.ts:1069-1073). The goalRef checks at :332 and :552 judge the Goal's active Plan read at :324-332 and :547-552; proposePlan refuses a draft whose goalId differs (plan-service.ts:1472) and plan revisions are immutable. Snapshots are never deleted (sqlite-record-store.ts:105 deletes only identity claims), so only a hand-edited/corrupted or foreign store can make a missing round/Run or a Plan of another Goal reach these arms: U, not G (a bogus roundRef is refused by the projection guard at task-machine.ts:1108-1112 before the read at :359) and not D2 (those stored shapes are decodable and would take the arms).
rows.proposal: Keep the three refusals untested and do not add Codex's bogus-round test: the projection guard refuses a non-head round first, and reaching :223 needs a deleted/foreign snapshot (AGENTS.md rule 4: no tamper test). If the lead decides to drop the two goalRef checks (:332, :552), that is a separate simplification; the not_found map for a missing round/Run should stay so a damaged store is not read as an incomplete or PASS task.
